VariationMode.Name: Token Variation Mode
VariationMode.Hint: How to select token art when multiple variations are available for a creature.

EnabledCompendiums.Name: Enabled Compendiums
EnabledCompendiums.Hint: Which compendiums to use for finding creature tokens.

CompendiumSelector.Name: Select Compendiums
CompendiumSelector.Label: Configure Compendiums
CompendiumSelector.Hint: Choose which official D&D compendiums to search for creature tokens.
CompendiumSelector.Title: Compendium Selection
CompendiumSelector.ModeDefaultHint: Automatically read every official D&D source installed in this world - the system SRD plus every Wizards of the Coast module. Newly installed books are picked up on their own.
CompendiumSelector.ModeAllHint: Also include packages that look official but are not in the known list, premium D&D content from other publishers, and any source you added manually below.
CompendiumSelector.ModeCustomHint: Manually select which compendiums to use from the list below.
CompendiumSelector.Saved: Compendium settings saved. The index will be reloaded on next use.
CompendiumSelector.SaveError: Failed to save compendium settings. Please try again.
CompendiumSelector.ModeCoreHint: Restrict matching to official SRD and rulebook content (Monster Manual, Player's Handbook, Dungeon Master's Guide, Tasha's). Adventures, expansions and non-official sources are ignored.

DialogTimeout.Name: Preview Dialog Timeout (minutes)
DialogTimeout.Hint: How long to wait before auto-closing the preview dialog. Increase for large scenes or slow review.

HttpTimeout.Name: HTTP Timeout (seconds)
HttpTimeout.Hint: Timeout for network requests when resolving wildcard token paths. Increase for slow connections.

AdditionalSources.Name: Additional Compendium Sources
AdditionalSources.Hint: Package ids or compendium ids to treat as official creature sources, separated by commas. Only needed for content this module cannot recognise on its own.

OverwriteImportedActors.Name: Overwrite D&D Beyond Imports
OverwriteImportedActors.Hint: When a creature was already imported into the world by D&D Beyond Importer, overwrite that actor in place with the official compendium version (keeping its folder and ownership) instead of importing a duplicate. Every overwrite is listed in the preview before it happens.

NPC_REPLACER.NewOfficialSources: New official D&D content detected: {names}. It is not used yet — enable it from Module Settings → NPC Token Replacer → Configure Compendiums ("Everything Detected", or tick it under "Custom Selection").
NPC_REPLACER.PreviewActorsTitle: D&D Beyond actors in this world
NPC_REPLACER.ActorsOverwritten: {count} D&D Beyond actor(s) overwritten with the official version.
NPC_REPLACER.ActorsOverwriteFailed: {count} D&D Beyond actor(s) could not be overwritten — see the console for details.
NPC_REPLACER.NewOfficialSourcesEnabled: New official D&D book detected and enabled automatically: {names}. Its creatures are now used for token replacement.
NPC_REPLACER.ActorsSkippedLoadError: A compendium failed to load, so D&D Beyond actors were not updated this time (tokens are still replaced). Try again once it loads.
NPC_REPLACER.StaleCode: NPC Token Replacer {installed} is installed, but your browser is still running cached code from {running}. Reload the page bypassing the cache: Ctrl+Shift+R (Cmd+Shift+R on Mac), or restart the desktop app.
NPC_REPLACER.ErrorUnexpected: Token replacement failed unexpectedly. Check the browser console for details.
NPC_REPLACER.TokensSkipped: Left unchanged: {replaced} token(s) already replaced by this module and {inCombat} in an encounter. Select them to replace them anyway.
